prediction_miss.verdict: MISSED, on both axes. Recorded because it was written down before the spend, which is the entire point of writing it down.
prediction_miss.what_it_means: The bare control nearly aces this task unaided — the same pattern the first six fixtures produced ('the model class aces in-context tasks without help'). The SCORE axis therefore has ~8 points of headroom and is close to saturated.
prediction_miss.why_the_campaign_still_has_power: The primary metric is silent_defect_rate, not score, and it is NOT saturated: bare vanilla claimed done with 1 of 8 documented behaviours broken. The decisive comparison (P1: standard-loop vs vanilla-configured) is still live and still falsifiable in both directions — if vanilla-configured also reaches 0.0, P1 is falsified and check admission is theatre.
prediction_miss.power_risk_stated_honestly: With 8 dimensions, silent_defect_rate moves in steps of 0.125 per dimension per trial (0.042 on a 3-trial mean). Against the ~16pt same-arm variance measured on this model class, a small true effect may not separate from noise at 3 trials/arm. If the arms come back within one dimension of each other, the honest report is 'no separable difference at this power', NOT a win for either side.
